_comment: Registry of every environment variable home code reads or sets (hooks/tests/test_config_inventory.py fails on an unregistered or a stale name). A registry (config/registry/): config/local.json can't override it. Per entry: source = who provides the value (system: the OS, shell or pytest; claude-code: Claude Code itself; repo: a repo's .claude/settings.json env, agents can't change it; internal: one home program hands it to another; test: only tests or a person running them set it); purpose; set_by; read_by; default = what homeconfig.env(<name>) returns when the variable is unset or empty (null: no value, the reader treats it as off/absent); allowed (optional) = the only values it may have: anything else, a typo included, is a ConfigError, never a silent fallback to the default. A repo-provided value always has a non-null default here. Variables marked 'direct' in read_by are still read straight from os.environ / $VAR (moving them behind homeconfig.env is a later stage).

WT_MAIN_DIR.purpose: The main checkout of a headless worker run (where events, the queue and auto-merge act).
WT_MAIN_DIR.set_by: worker-control.py (the run-worker.sh environment); reconciler.py (the programs it starts detached: run-steps.py wrapup, worker-control.py auto-start, run-steps.py reconcile)
WT_MAIN_DIR.read_by: direct: run-worker.sh, worker-control.py, auto-merge.py, auto-finish.py, verify.py, verifier.py; homeconfig.env: run-steps.py (the run record's comparison at the wrapper's exit); the wt-pane mod ($.env.get: set = a worker process)

CLAUDE_WORKER_MINUTES.purpose: The run's minute budget; set only in a headless worker run, so it also marks one.
CLAUDE_WORKER_MINUTES.read_by: direct: agent_guard.py, dispatch_guard.py, worker_budget.py, worker-progress.py, worker-stop.py; homeconfig.env: hookio.py (role)

CLAUDE_WORKER_COMPACT.purpose: Marks the wrapper's own /compact invocation, which worker-stop.py skips.

CLAUDE_COST_HOOK_INPUT.purpose: The SubagentStop hook input handed to subagent-cost.py's detached child.

CLAUDE_COST_WAIT.purpose: Seconds subagent-cost.py waits for the transcript to settle; unset = subagent-cost.py's own WAIT_SECONDS default (30), not yet read through homeconfig.env.
CLAUDE_COST_WAIT.set_by: nothing in home code (a manual override)

CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS.purpose: How long claude -p keeps waiting for background work at exit; the run's minutes, so a held code-reviewer isn't killed.

CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.purpose: The session's project checkout, given to hooks.
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.read_by: direct: hookonly.py, plan_guard.py, write_scope.py, skills/repo-plan/repo-check.py; homeconfig.env: hookio.py (the checkout root, no cwd fallback)

HOME.set_by: the OS / shell; hooks/tools/public-check.py sets it to the fake home of its clean-install suite run

UV_CACHE_DIR.purpose: uv's cache directory. hooks/tools/public-check.py runs the suite with HOME set to a fake home and passes the cache the configured uv reports (`uv cache dir`), so `uv run --offline` finds the packages it already has.

PATH.set_by: the OS / shell; run-worker.sh prepends ~/.local/bin and /usr/local/go/bin

QG_HOOKS_DIR.purpose: Points the hook tests at another hooks/ tree (a draft copy).

WP_HOOKS_DIR.purpose: Points test_worker_progress.py at another hooks/ tree.

CLAUDE_HOME_SUITE.purpose: Recursion guard of the hook test suite: the pid of the pytest session that holds the suite; a session that finds it held by another pid stops before collecting, except a pytest-xdist worker (its config has workerinput) whose parent process holds it (hooks/RULES.md T7).
CLAUDE_HOME_SUITE.set_by: hooks/tests/conftest.py (pytest_configure, inherited by every process the suite starts)
CLAUDE_HOME_SUITE.read_by: hooks/tests/conftest.py (the same setdefault: the value it returns is the holder)
